Last year's Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro was an instant hit upon release, but reports indicate that the iPhone 18 Pro will replace that colour with a brand new wine red shade. Below is a preview compiled based on the latest leaked information.

iPhone 18 Pro Headline New Colour Preview

Apple has always favoured understated colour options for its Pro series iPhones. But with the iPhone 17 Pro, Apple dramatically shifted its strategy, breaking away from its past approach of offering only black and white, and instead introduced the eye-catching Cosmic Orange, which was immediately met with great enthusiasm.

Reports suggest Apple plans to maintain the same bold colour direction for the iPhone 18 Pro.

However, this time around it's not expected to be another orange, but rather three (or possibly four) colour options:

  • Wine Red / Deep Cherry
  • Light Blue
  • Silver
  • Possibly Dark Grey

It remains unclear whether a dark grey or black will be offered this year, but there is fairly consistent consensus across the board on the remaining three colours.

Among them, the Deep Cherry / Wine Red is expected to be Apple's flagship marketing colour this time around.

Leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted on Weibo today, stating that he had previously seen both light and dark versions of this colour online. However, he believes the correct tone should be the darker variant—a purple-toned red, resembling the colour of cherries.

Some reports have only referred to the colour as "red" or "dark red," which may explain why some renders show a lighter, redder tone. But according to the leaker, what we will see is a more purple-toned cherry colour.

What do you think of the rumoured headline new colour for the iPhone 18 Pro? Let us know in the comments.
